</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; maxRetries; attempt++) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    try {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      const response = await fetch(url);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      if (response.status === 429) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        const data = await response.json();<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        const retryAfter = data.retry_after || Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        console.log(`Rate limited. Retrying after ${retryAfter}ms...`);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        await sleep(retryAfter);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        continue;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      return response;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    } catch (error) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      if (attempt === maxRetries - 1) throw error;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      await sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">function sleep(ms) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  return new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, ms));<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div><script type="d7c2d4cceb9dd8f74896db95-text/javascript">$RC("B:10","S:10")</script><div hidden id="S:11"><div id="_R_2ul39bsnqj6iv5ubsnpfivb_" aria-busy="false" class="group/codeblock shiki relative flex shrink flex-col overflow-hidden print:overflow-visible circular-corners:rounded-2xl rounded-corners:rounded-xl straight-corners:rounded-xs [&amp;:has([data-codeblock-focus]:focus)]:ring-2 [&amp;:has([data-codeblock-focus]:focus)]:ring-primary-hover decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl layout-wide:max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full print:break-inside-avoid" data-color-scheme="light dark"><span data-codeblock-focus="true" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true" class="pointer-events-none absolute size-0 outline-none"></span><div class="flex items-center justify-start gap-2 text-sm"></div><div class="relative flex min-h-0 flex-col"><div class="absolute right-2 z-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-sans leading-none opacity-0 group-hover/codeblock:opacity-11 has-[button:focus-visible]:opacity-11 top-2"><button type="button" class="button group/button inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl straight-corners:rounded-none circular-corners:rounded-3xl border border-tint hover:border-tint-hover disabled:border-tint depth-subtle:shadow-xs hover:depth-subtle:shadow-md focus-visible:depth-subtle:shadow-md active:depth-subtle:shadow-xs shadow-tint/6 dark:shadow-tint-1 not-focus-visible:outline-0 contrast-more:border-tint-12 contrast-more:hover:outline-2 contrast-more:hover:outline-tint-12 contrast-more:hover:border-tint-12 contrast-more:focus-visible:border-tint-12 contrast-more:focus-visible:outline-tint-12 hover:depth-subtle:-translate-y-px focus-visible:depth-subtle:-translate-y-px aria-expanded:depth-subtle:-translate-y-px active:depth-subtle:translate-y-0 transition-all grow-0 shrink-0 truncate max-w-full align-middle disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:translate-y-0! </span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  constructor(maxRequests = 3000, windowMs = 3600000) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    this.maxRequests = maxRequests;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    this.windowMs = windowMs;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    this.requests = new Map(); // entity -&gt; [timestamps]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  async throttle(entity = &#x27;default&#x27;) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    const now = Date.now();<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Get request history for this entity<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    if (!this.requests.has(entity)) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      this.requests.set(entity, []);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    const entityRequests = this.requests.get(entity);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Remove old requests outside the window<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    const validRequests = entityRequests.filter(<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      time =&gt; now - time &lt; this.windowMs<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    );<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Check if we&#x27;re at the limit<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    if (validRequests.length &gt;= this.maxRequests) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      const oldestRequest = validRequests[0];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      const waitTime = this.windowMs - (now - oldestRequest);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      console.log(`Throttling ${entity}: waiting ${waitTime}ms`);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      await sleep(waitTime);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      // Recursively try again<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">      return this.throttle(entity);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Add this request to history<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    validRequests.push(now);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    this.requests.set(entity, validRequests);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">// Usage<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">const limiter = new RateLimiter(3000, 3600000); // 3000/hour<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">async function makeRequest(url, entity) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  await limiter.throttle(entity);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">  return fetch(url);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">// These will be automatically throttled<!-- -->

class="table max-h-full w-fit min-w-full [counter-reset:line] print:max-h-none print:whitespace-pre-wrap [[aria-expanded=false]_&amp;]:mask-b-from-50%"><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">import time<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">import requests<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">from datetime import datetime, timedelta<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">from typing import Dict, List, Optional<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">class RateLimiter:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    def __init__(self, max_requests: int = 3000, window_seconds: int = 3600):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.max_requests = max_requests<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.window_seconds = window_seconds<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.requests: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    def throttle(self, entity: str = &#x27;default&#x27;):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        now = time.time()<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if entity not in self.requests:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            self.requests[entity] = []<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Remove old requests<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.requests[entity] = [<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            req_time for req_time in self.requests[entity]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            if now - req_time &lt; self.window_seconds<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        ]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Check if at limit<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if len(self.requests[entity]) &gt;= self.max_requests:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            oldest = self.requests[entity][0]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            wait_time = self.window_seconds - (now - oldest)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            print(f&quot;Throttling {entity}: waiting {wait_time:.2f}s&quot;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            time.sleep(wait_time)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            return self.throttle(entity)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Add this request<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.requests[entity].append(now)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">class SportmonksAPI:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    def __init__(self, api_token: str):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.token = api_token<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.base_url = &#x27;https://api.sportmonks.com/v3/football&#x27;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.cache = {}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.limiter = RateLimiter(max_requests=2800)  # Leave buffer<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    def request(self, endpoint: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None, entity: str = &#x27;default&#x27;):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Throttle<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.limiter.throttle(entity)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Build request<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        url = f&quot;{self.base_url}{endpoint}&quot;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if params is None:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            params = {}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        params[&#x27;api_token&#x27;] = self.token<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        # Make request with retry<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        for attempt in range(3):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            try:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                response = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=30)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                if response.status_code == 429:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    retry_after = response.json().get(&#x27;retry_after&#x27;, 2 ** attempt)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    print(f&quot;Rate limited. Retrying after {retry_after}s&quot;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    time.sleep(retry_after)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    continue<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                response.raise_for_status()<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                data = response.json()<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                # Log rate limit<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                if &#x27;rate_limit&#x27; in data:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    remaining = data[&#x27;rate_limit&#x27;][&#x27;remaining&#x27;]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    print(f&quot;{entity}: {remaining} remaining&quot;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                return data<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                if attempt == 2:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    raise<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    def get_types(self):<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        cache_key = &#x27;types&#x27;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        cache_duration = timedelta(weeks=1)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if cache_key in self.cache:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            data, timestamp = self.cache[cache_key]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            if datetime.now() - timestamp &lt; cache_duration:<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                print(&quot;Using cached types&quot;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                return data<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        response = self.request(&#x27;/core/types&#x27;, entity=&#x27;Type&#x27;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        self.cache[cache_key] = (response[&#x27;data&#x27;], datetime.now())<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        return response[&#x27;data&#x27;]<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content"># Usage<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">api = SportmonksAPI(&#x27;YOUR_TOKEN&#x27;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">fixtures = api.request(&#x27;/fixtures&#x27;, {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    &#x27;filters&#x27;: &#x27;fixtureLeagues:501&#x27;,<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    &#x27;include&#x27;: &#x27;participants;scores&#x27;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}, &#x27;Fixture&#x27;)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">types = api.get_types()  # Cached</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div><script class="table max-h-full w-fit min-w-full [counter-reset:line] print:max-h-none print:whitespace-pre-wrap [[aria-expanded=false]_&amp;]:mask-b-from-50%"><span class="highlight-line"><span </span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">class RateLimiter {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $maxRequests;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $windowSeconds;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $requests = [];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function __construct($maxRequests = 3000, $windowSeconds = 3600) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;maxRequests = $maxRequests;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function throttle($entity = &#x27;default&#x27;) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $now = time();<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Initialise entity if needed<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if (!isset($this-&gt;requests[$entity])) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $this-&gt;requests[$entity] = [];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Remove old requests outside the window<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;requests[$entity] = array_filter(<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $this-&gt;requests[$entity],<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            function($timestamp) use ($now) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                return ($now - $timestamp) &lt; $this-&gt;windowSeconds;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        );<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Check if at limit<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if (count($this-&gt;requests[$entity]) &gt;= $this-&gt;maxRequests) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $oldestRequest = min($this-&gt;requests[$entity]);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $waitTime = $this-&gt;windowSeconds - ($now - $oldestRequest);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            echo &quot;Throttling {$entity}: waiting {$waitTime}s\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            sleep($waitTime);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            // Try again recursively<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            return $this-&gt;throttle($entity);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Add this request to history<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;requests[$entity][] = $now;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">class SportmonksAPI {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $token;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $baseUrl = &#x27;https://api.sportmonks.com/v3/football&#x27;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $cache = [];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private $limiter;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function __construct($apiToken, $maxRequests = 2800) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;token = $apiToken;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;limiter = new RateLimiter($maxRequests);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function request($endpoint, $params = [], $entity = &#x27;default&#x27;, $maxRetries = 3) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Throttle request<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;limiter-&gt;throttle($entity);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Build URL<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $params[&#x27;api_token&#x27;] = $this-&gt;token;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $url = $this-&gt;baseUrl . $endpoint . &#x27;?&#x27; . http_build_query($params);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        // Make request with retry logic<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        for ($attempt = 0; $attempt &lt; $maxRetries; $attempt++) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            try {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                $response = $this-&gt;fetchWithRetry($url, $attempt);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                $data = json_decode($response, true);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                // Log rate limit info<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                if (isset($data[&#x27;rate_limit&#x27;])) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    $this-&gt;logRateLimit($data[&#x27;rate_limit&#x27;]);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                return $data;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            } catch (Exception $e) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                if ($attempt === $maxRetries - 1) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                    throw $e;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                // Exponential backoff<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                $waitTime = pow(2, $attempt);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                echo &quot;Request failed. Retrying after {$waitTime}s...\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                sleep($waitTime);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private function fetchWithRetry($url, $attempt) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $ch = curl_init();<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 30);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $response = curl_exec($ch);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        curl_close($ch);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if ($httpCode === 429) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $data = json_decode($response, true);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $retryAfter = $data[&#x27;retry_after&#x27;] ?? pow(2, $attempt);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            echo &quot;Rate limited. Retrying after {$retryAfter}s...\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            sleep($retryAfter);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            // Retry recursively<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            return $this-&gt;fetchWithRetry($url, $attempt);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if ($httpCode !== 200) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            throw new Exception(&quot;HTTP {$httpCode}: {$response}&quot;);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        return $response;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    private function logRateLimit($rateLimit) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $remaining = $rateLimit[&#x27;remaining&#x27;] ?? &#x27;?&#x27;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $entity = $rateLimit[&#x27;requested_entity&#x27;] ?? &#x27;Unknown&#x27;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        echo &quot;{$entity}: {$remaining} requests remaining\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if ($remaining &lt; 200) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            echo &quot;⚠️ Low on {$entity} requests! Optimize your calls.\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Cached method for types<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function getTypes() {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $cacheKey = &#x27;types&#x27;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $cacheDuration = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60; // 1 week<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if (isset($this-&gt;cache[$cacheKey])) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            $cached = $this-&gt;cache[$cacheKey];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            if (time() - $cached[&#x27;timestamp&#x27;] &lt; $cacheDuration) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                echo &quot;Using cached types\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">                return $cached[&#x27;data&#x27;];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        echo &quot;Fetching fresh types\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $response = $this-&gt;request(&#x27;/core/types&#x27;, [], &#x27;Type&#x27;);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $this-&gt;cache[$cacheKey] = [<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            &#x27;data&#x27; =&gt; $response[&#x27;data&#x27;],<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            &#x27;timestamp&#x27; =&gt; time()<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        ];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        return $response[&#x27;data&#x27;];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Helper method for batched requests<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    public function getFixturesByIds($ids) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        if (empty($ids)) {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">            return [];<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        $idsString = implode(&#x27;,&#x27;, $ids);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        return $this-&gt;request(&quot;/fixtures/multi/{$idsString}&quot;, [], &#x27;Fixture&#x27;);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    }<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">}<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">// Usage Example<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">try {<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    $api = new SportmonksAPI(&#x27;YOUR_TOKEN_HERE&#x27;);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Single fixture with includes<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    $fixture = $api-&gt;request(&#x27;/fixtures/123&#x27;, [<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">        &#x27;include&#x27; =&gt; &#x27;participants;scores;events&#x27;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    ], &#x27;Fixture&#x27;);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    echo &quot;Fixture: {$fixture[&#x27;data&#x27;][&#x27;name&#x27;]}\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Batched request<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    $multipleFixtures = $api-&gt;getFixturesByIds([123, 456, 789]);<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    echo &quot;Fetched &quot; . count($multipleFixtures[&#x27;data&#x27;]) . &quot; fixtures\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Cached types (only fetches once)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    $types = $api-&gt;getTypes();<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    echo &quot;Got &quot; . count($types) . &quot; types\n&quot;;<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    <!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    // Types from cache (0 API calls)<!-- -->
</span></span><span class="highlight-line"><span class="highlight-line-content">    $typesAgain = $api-&gt;getTypes();<!-- -->
